policy: Retain every eligible upstream repository. Select its strongest reviewed merged author contributions across the complete history, using technical depth and practical effect rather than recency. Describe the actual scope without inflating narrow fixes or catalog work.

scope.history_window: complete verified merged history; no recency cutoff

caveats: Repository coverage follows current eligibility and verified ranking; qualitative example selection never removes an eligible repository.
Representative work is a qualitative choice within each repository, not a claim that all projects received equally large contributions or original research.
Narrow fixes and catalog registrations retain their actual scope when those are the only verified merges in that repository.
LeRobot applies an existing V-JEPA 2 RoPE correction to a training predictor; no measured model-quality gain is claimed.
COLMAP work affects benchmark evaluation, not reconstruction solver performance.
Haystack isolates synchronous Pipeline.run visit counters via shallow copy.
Upstream test suites were not rerun during this profile review; committed regression cases were inspected.

rows.en: Parse XML roots and terminal control sequences structurally, preventing false SVG classification and preserving notebook text around cancelled or replaced controls.
rows.zh: 按结构解析 XML 根节点与终端控制序列，避免 SVG 误分类，并保留控制序列取消或替换后的 notebook 正文。
rows.reason: Reviewed all four directly merged historical PRs. #1184 adds bounded XML preamble/root parsing; #1258 handles 7-bit and 8-bit control-string termination, cancellation and replacement. These are the strongest combined parsing improvements among this repository’s available merged contributions. Closed #1250 was adopted through another PR and is excluded from the directly merged examples. Scope is content classification and notebook text rendering, without a claim of new algorithms or measured whole-system gains.
